overview.en: Luciocyprinus langsoni is a freshwater carp of the cyprinid family, described from northern Vietnam and reported from China and Vietnam.
overview.fr: Luciocyprinus langsoni est une carpe d’eau douce de la famille des cyprinidés, décrite du nord du Vietnam et signalée en Chine et au Vietnam.

identification.en: FishBase gives a reported maximum standard length of 79 cm and a published maximum weight of 15 kg; these are maxima, not typical adult sizes.
identification.fr: FishBase rapporte une longueur standard maximale de 79 cm et une masse maximale publiée de 15 kg ; ce sont des maxima, pas des tailles adultes habituelles.

habitat.en: Available summaries place it in freshwater, in a benthopelagic environment; detailed habitat preferences were not established in the sources reviewed.
habitat.fr: Les synthèses disponibles le situent en eau douce, dans un environnement benthopélagique ; les sources consultées ne précisent pas ses préférences fines d’habitat.

diet.en: The reviewed sources do not report its diet.
diet.fr: Les sources consultées ne décrivent pas son régime.

behavior.en: The reviewed sources do not describe its behavior.
behavior.fr: Les sources consultées ne décrivent pas son comportement.

reproduction.en: The reviewed sources do not describe its breeding.
reproduction.fr: Les sources consultées ne décrivent pas sa reproduction.

ecology.en: A 2024 mitochondrial-genome study reports two named species in Luciocyprinus: this species and L. striolatus; genetic data alone do not establish their ecological differences.
ecology.fr: Une étude de 2024 sur le génome mitochondrial rapporte deux espèces nommées dans le genre Luciocyprinus : celle-ci et L. striolatus ; les données génétiques seules n’établissent pas leurs différences écologiques.

conservation.en: A 2025 international freshwater-fish assessment table lists it as Vulnerable. Vietnam also includes it on a priority-protection list.
conservation.fr: Un tableau international d’évaluation des poissons d’eau douce de 2025 le classe vulnérable. Le Vietnam l’inscrit aussi sur une liste d’espèces prioritaires pour la protection.

title.fr: Luciocyprinus langsoni — Catalogue des poissons d’Eschmeyer, California Academy of Sciences

facts: The catalog records the valid name, northern Vietnamese type locality, freshwater habitat, and distribution in China and Vietnam.

facts: FishBase lists freshwater, benthopelagic habitat and published maxima of 79 cm standard length and 15 kg; its summary does not detail diet, behavior or breeding.
The concise FishBase account has no information on feeding, behavior, or reproduction; those fields remain undescribed here rather than inferred.

uncertainties: Species-specific natural history is very poorly represented in the accessible material reviewed; diet, behavior and reproduction are left explicitly undescribed. FishBase maxima are published extremes and should not be read as typical sizes. The conservation source is a 2025 compilation of status data and a Vietnamese list entry, not a new population survey.
review_note: Kept the account deliberately short because accessible primary and institutional sources are sparse; cross-checked range and maxima with the California Academy of Sciences and FishBase, and kept the limited genus comparison separate from behavioral claims.
